items.title: Lifting a formally smooth complete local algebra along a residue field extension
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma lifts a formally smooth Noetherian complete local algebra over a residue field to a formally smooth local algebra over a Noetherian complete local ring, with prescribed special fibre. The proof reuses the standard diagram of a power series ring over a Cohen ring mapping to the target: because both the target and the special fibre of the power series ring are regular, the kernel of the surjection onto the target is generated by elements that extend to a regular system of parameters, and cutting the power series ring down by lifts of those elements leaves a power series ring whose special fibre is the target itself. The map from the Cohen ring is then formally smooth by the flat-fibre criterion, and base change along the given ring map produces the required lift.
